theme.en: AI Demand Rewires the Full Chip Stack
theme.zh: AI需求重塑整个芯片堆栈

dek.en: Nvidia's MediaTek investment widens the custom-silicon ecosystem while new memory, foundry, packaging, metrology, and EDA work attacks the bottlenecks around compute. The center of gravity is shifting from peak FLOPS to moving, manufacturing, and testing data-intensive systems.
dek.zh: Nvidia入股MediaTek，进一步扩大定制芯片生态；与此同时，存储、晶圆代工、封装、量测和EDA环节都在着手解决算力周边的瓶颈。产业重心正从峰值FLOPS转向如何搬运、制造和测试数据密集型系统。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion in MediaTek to expand NVLink Fusion
title.zh: Nvidia向MediaTek投资35亿美元，扩大NVLink Fusion生态

summary.en: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion in MediaTek, and MediaTek will offer NVLink Fusion to customers building custom XPUs. The deal gives Nvidia another route into hyperscaler and system-company silicon while strengthening MediaTek's position beyond its traditional mobile-chip base. It also turns NVLink adoption into a financial as well as a technical partnership.
summary.zh: Nvidia将向MediaTek投资35亿美元，MediaTek则会向定制XPU客户提供NVLink Fusion。该交易为Nvidia进入云厂商和系统公司的定制芯片项目增加了一条路径，也强化了MediaTek在传统移动芯片业务之外的地位。NVLink的推广由此同时具备技术合作和资本绑定两层含义。

title.en: Nvidia brings RISC-V into its GPU and NVLink Fusion roadmap
title.zh: Nvidia将RISC-V纳入GPU与NVLink Fusion路线图

summary.en: Nvidia discussed CUDA for RISC-V and the role of RISC-V processors in NVLink Fusion systems at Hot Chips 2026. Supporting an open CPU ISA alongside Nvidia GPUs broadens the range of custom hosts and controllers that can participate in its scale-up ecosystem. The presentation signals platform direction rather than a quantified product launch.
summary.zh: Nvidia在Hot Chips 2026讨论了面向RISC-V的CUDA，以及RISC-V处理器在NVLink Fusion系统中的作用。在Nvidia GPU旁支持开放CPU指令集，可扩大能够接入其scale-up生态的定制主机和控制器范围。这场演讲反映的是平台方向，并非带有量化指标的新品发布。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Intel says 14A is improving faster than any node since 2012
title.zh: Intel称14A改善速度为2012年以来最快

summary.en: Intel CFO David Zinsner says defect-density improvement on the 14A process is the company's fastest since its 22 nm node launched in 2012. A steep early defect-learning curve would improve Intel Foundry's chances of attracting external customers and supporting its own 14A products. The claim is an executive update, however, and does not establish production yield or volume readiness.
summary.zh: Intel首席财务官David Zinsner表示，14A制程的缺陷密度改善速度是公司自2012年推出22 nm节点以来最快的一次。更陡峭的早期缺陷学习曲线有助于Intel Foundry争取外部客户，也有利于自有14A产品。但这一说法仍属于管理层进展更新，不能等同于量产良率或产能已经就绪。

title.en: Sony and TSMC deepen their image-sensor manufacturing partnership
title.zh: Sony与TSMC深化图像传感器制造合作

summary.en: A Sony-TSMC venture is combining Sony's image-sensor expertise with TSMC manufacturing capacity for markets including AI and robotics. The arrangement links a major sensor supplier more tightly to foundry capacity as machine-vision demand spreads beyond smartphones. Its importance will depend on the venture's eventual process mix, capacity, and customer programs, which the candidate report does not quantify.
summary.zh: Sony与TSMC的新合资安排把Sony的图像传感器能力与TSMC的制造产能结合起来，目标市场包括AI和机器人。随着机器视觉需求从智能手机扩展到更多领域，这项合作让主要传感器供应商与晶圆代工产能绑定得更紧。候选报道未给出制程组合、产能和客户项目等量化信息，这些因素将决定其最终影响。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Samsung targets 2x performance for HBM5 while zHBM baselines diverge
title.zh: Samsung为HBM5设定2倍性能目标，zHBM对比基线仍存分歧

summary.en: Samsung's memory roadmap targets twice the performance for HBM5 and promotes an eightfold figure for zHBM. XenoSpectrum cautions that the zHBM comparison uses conflicting baselines, so the two multipliers should not be read as directly comparable product gains. The roadmap still shows Samsung pushing both conventional bandwidth scaling and more structural changes to memory integration.
summary.zh: Samsung的存储路线图把HBM5性能目标设为2倍，并为zHBM提出8倍指标。XenoSpectrum提醒，zHBM的比较采用了相互冲突的基线，因此不能把这两个倍数直接理解为可横向比较的产品增益。即便如此，这份路线图仍表明Samsung正同时推进传统带宽扩展和更具结构性的存储集成变革。

title.en: AMD says hybrid-bonded 3D DRAM can cut memory energy 17-fold
title.zh: AMD称混合键合3D DRAM可将存储能耗降低17倍

summary.en: AMD says a hybrid-bonded 3D DRAM design is 17 times more energy-efficient than an HBM stack connected with microbumps. Removing bump-scale interconnect overhead could materially reduce the energy cost of feeding AI compute, but AMD also identifies thermal constraints as a barrier to commercialization. The result is therefore a roadmap signal, not evidence of a production-ready HBM replacement.
summary.zh: AMD表示，采用混合键合的3D DRAM设计，其能效可达到微凸点互连HBM堆栈的17倍。消除微凸点尺度的互连开销，有望显著降低为AI计算供数的能耗，但AMD同时指出散热约束仍阻碍商业化。因此，这更像是路线图信号，而不是已经可量产的HBM替代方案。

title.en: ICY Tech positions MRAM for rack-scale AI inference
title.zh: ICY Tech将MRAM瞄准机架级AI推理

summary.en: Chinese MRAM developer ICY Tech is proposing a memory approach for rack-scale AI inference rather than competing with HBM on the same terms. Nonvolatile MRAM could change how weights are retained and moved in inference systems, where capacity and data movement often dominate. The candidate report provides no deployment, capacity, or performance figures, so the concept still needs system-level validation.
summary.zh: 中国MRAM厂商ICY Tech提出面向机架级AI推理的存储方案，而不是在相同路径上直接与HBM竞争。非易失MRAM可能改变推理系统中权重的保存和搬运方式；在这类系统里，容量与数据移动通常是主要约束。候选报道没有给出部署、容量或性能数据，因此这一概念仍需系统级验证。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Rigaku and Tohoku University form a soft X-ray metrology institute
title.zh: Rigaku与东北大学成立软X射线量测研究机构

summary.en: Rigaku and Tohoku University are creating a research institute that combines soft X-ray tools, information science, and semiconductor process expertise. More complex three-dimensional structures make nondestructive, high-resolution metrology increasingly important for process control. The initiative is an R&D commitment; the report does not yet specify a production tool, customer, or deployment schedule.
summary.zh: Rigaku与东北大学将成立研究机构，把软X射线工具、信息科学和半导体工艺能力结合起来。随着三维结构日益复杂，无损、高分辨率量测对制程控制的重要性持续上升。这是一项研发投入，报道尚未给出量产设备、客户或部署时间表。

title.en: Keysight ADS supports first-pass silicon across 100 GHz to 3 THz
title.zh: Keysight ADS支持100 GHz至3 THz设计的一次流片成功

summary.en: AttoTude says its Keysight ADS workflow supports IC design from 100 GHz to 3 THz and has cut development cycles by more than 50%. First-pass silicon at these frequencies would reduce costly respins in a design space where models, packaging, and measurement are tightly coupled. The performance and cycle-time figures are company-reported and should be read as a workflow case study rather than a broad benchmark.
summary.zh: AttoTude表示，其Keysight ADS工作流覆盖100 GHz至3 THz的IC设计，并将开发周期缩短了50%以上。在这些频率上实现一次流片成功，可减少高成本的重复流片，因为模型、封装和测量在这一设计空间中高度耦合。相关性能和周期数据来自公司披露，更适合作为工作流案例，而非普适基准。

title.en: Diodes acquires ElevATE to expand its semiconductor-test portfolio
title.zh: Diodes收购ElevATE，扩充半导体测试产品组合

summary.en: Diodes is acquiring ElevATE Semiconductor to add low-power analog and mixed-signal products used in automated test equipment. Rising device complexity increases demand for more channels, precision, and power control in production test, giving the deal relevance beyond portfolio expansion. The report does not disclose transaction value or integration targets.
summary.zh: Diodes将收购ElevATE Semiconductor，补充用于自动测试设备的低功耗模拟和混合信号产品。器件复杂度上升，推动量产测试对更多通道、更高精度和更精细电源控制的需求，因此该交易不仅是简单的产品线扩充。报道未披露交易金额或整合目标。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Taiwan's digital ministry promotes expansion of local compute capacity
title.zh: 台湾数位发展部门推动本地算力扩张

summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs is promoting an expansion of domestic computing capacity. Local capacity policy matters because access to AI infrastructure increasingly shapes cloud services, model development, and demand for accelerators and data-center components. The candidate item does not quantify funding, megawatts, or procurement volumes, so the immediate semiconductor impact remains uncertain.
summary.zh: 台湾数位发展主管部门正在推动本地算力扩张。算力基础设施的可获得性日益影响云服务、模型开发，以及对加速器和数据中心部件的需求，因此本地算力政策具有产业意义。候选报道未量化资金、兆瓦规模或采购量，短期半导体影响仍不确定。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: South Korea's August semiconductor exports reach a record $46.7 billion
title.zh: 韩国8月半导体出口创纪录，达到467亿美元

summary.en: South Korea's semiconductor exports reached a record $46.7 billion in August, with AI demand cited as the main driver. The figure captures the strength of the country's memory-heavy supply base and the spillover from accelerator deployments into HBM and related components. One monthly record does not by itself separate price increases from shipment growth, so the mix behind the total still matters.
summary.zh: 韩国8月半导体出口额创下467亿美元纪录，报道将AI需求列为主要驱动力。该数据反映出韩国以存储为主的供应基础持续强劲，也体现了加速器部署向HBM及相关部件的外溢效应。单月纪录本身无法区分价格上涨与出货增长，各部分对总额的贡献仍然重要。

theme.en: Inference Co-Design Targets Movement, Routing, and Scheduling
theme.zh: 推理协同设计转向数据移动、路由与调度

dek.en: This week's papers treat memory traffic and execution structure as first-class design variables, from IMC fabrics and block-diffusion accelerators to MoE routing and speculative-serving schedulers. Most results are still preprints or modeled systems, making implementation evidence the central caveat.
dek.zh: 本周论文把存储流量与执行结构提升为核心设计变量，覆盖IMC互连、block-diffusion加速器、MoE路由和推测式服务调度。多数结果仍是预印本或建模系统，能否获得真实实现证据是主要限制。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: JENGA: RowHammer defenses can undermine real-time predictability
title.zh: JENGA：RowHammer防护可能破坏实时可预测性

papers.authors: V. Abgrall, M. Traiola, R. Salvador, et al.

summary.en: JENGA shows that counter-based RowHammer defenses can introduce large timing variations into safety-critical real-time systems. The attack manipulates the internal state of a Per-Row-Activation-Counter mechanism standardized for recent DDR5 devices, turning a security defense into a source of worst-case execution-time uncertainty. The paper is a preprint, and the practical risk depends on how closely evaluated controllers match deployed PRAC implementations.
summary.zh: JENGA表明，基于计数器的RowHammer防护可能给安全关键实时系统引入较大的时序波动。该攻击操纵近期DDR5所标准化的Per-Row-Activation-Counter机制内部状态，把安全防御转化为最坏执行时间的不确定来源。论文仍是预印本，实际风险取决于评估控制器与已部署PRAC实现的接近程度。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: A block-diffusion LLM accelerator for edge devices
title.zh: 面向边缘设备的Block-Diffusion LLM加速器

papers.authors: W.-H. Huang, K. Lee, M.-Y. Lee, et al.

summary.en: This work co-designs wide-I/O LPDDR, precision-tagged KV reads, feed-forward reuse, and a mixed-precision systolic array for block-diffusion LLMs at batch one. On modeled Jetson-class platforms with 1.5B and 7B models, the authors report mean energy reductions of 3.79x and 3.96x and latency speedups of 2.88x and 4.44x, with benchmark losses below one percentage point. The gains are simulation-based rather than measured silicon, and several techniques depend on the execution properties of native block diffusion.
summary.zh: 该工作针对batch-one的block-diffusion LLM，协同设计宽I/O LPDDR、带精度标签的KV读取、前馈网络复用和混合精度脉动阵列。在建模的Jetson级平台上，1.5B与7B模型分别实现平均3.79倍和3.96倍能耗降低，以及2.88倍和4.44倍延迟加速，基准分数下降小于1个百分点。结果来自仿真而非实测硅片，且多项技术依赖原生block diffusion的执行特性。

title.en: LEAP balances LLM inference across IMC, near-memory, and on-network compute
title.zh: LEAP在存内、近存与网内计算之间平衡LLM推理

papers.authors: Y. Wang, Y. J. Chong, X. Fong

summary.en: LEAP maps static weights to in-memory-compute processing elements, dynamic intermediates to near-memory compute, and partial-result reduction to in-network compute. A companion partitioning and scheduling layer changes the mapping for the distinct arithmetic intensity of prefill and decode. The framework attacks data movement across a scale-up fabric, but the preprint describes a co-design proposal rather than a measured chip.
summary.zh: LEAP把静态权重映射到存内计算处理单元，把动态中间数据交给近存计算，并用网内计算完成部分结果归约。配套的分区与调度层针对prefill和decode不同的算术强度调整映射。该框架瞄准scale-up互连中的数据移动，但预印本描述的是协同设计方案，并非实测芯片。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 硬件相关AI研究

title.en: OUTLETS predicts output length from speculative-decoding states
title.zh: OUTLETS利用推测解码状态预测输出长度

papers.authors: W. Wen, Y. Liu, Y. Liu, et al.

summary.en: OUTLETS reuses hidden representations already produced by a speculative-decoding draft model to predict generation length with only a lightweight regression head. The authors report lower mean absolute error than evaluated proxy and internal-state methods, then use the predictions to improve scheduling under saturated disaggregated serving. The systems benefit depends on already running a compatible speculative backbone and on workload length distributions matching the evaluation.
summary.zh: OUTLETS复用推测解码draft model已经生成的隐藏表示，仅增加轻量回归头来预测生成长度。作者报告其平均绝对误差低于所评估的代理模型和内部状态方法，并利用预测结果改善饱和状态下的解耦式服务调度。系统收益取决于是否已运行兼容的推测解码骨干，也取决于实际工作负载的长度分布是否与评估相符。

title.en: PCoMoE replaces whole-expert selection with fine-grained path composition
title.zh: PCoMoE以细粒度路径组合取代整专家选择

papers.authors: Z. Gan, F. Liu, C. Guan, et al.

summary.en: PCoMoE decomposes MoE experts into reusable sub-expert paths, then prunes compatible path combinations and executes them with a hardware-oriented runtime. The paper reports up to 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while also reporting a 10% accuracy improvement over its comparison point. Because both gains come from a preprint evaluation, the accuracy baseline and runtime overhead deserve close inspection before generalizing the result.
summary.zh: PCoMoE把MoE专家拆分为可复用的子专家路径，再剪除低价值的兼容路径组合，并用面向硬件的运行时执行。论文报告端到端推理最高加速1.31倍，同时相对其比较基线提高10%的准确率。由于两项增益都来自预印本评估，在推广结论前需要仔细核对准确率基线和运行时开销。

title.en: Contrastive routing sharpens specialization in modular MoE models
title.zh: 对比式路由增强模块化MoE模型的专家分工

papers.authors: N. Xiros, D. Damianos, M.-E. Zoumpoulidi, et al.

summary.en: CoRM routes each token by contrasting it with an exponential-moving-average reference state, aiming to remove features shared across tokens and expose a more separable routing subspace. Across nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, the authors report gains of 0.67 to 1.69 points for Top-1 routing and 1.38 to 1.77 points for Top-2, at costs of 2.9% more parameters and 2.6% more FLOPs per token. The results improve specialization, but the added compute and benchmark-only evidence leave serving efficiency unproven.
summary.zh: CoRM把每个token与指数移动平均参考状态进行对比式路由，以滤除token之间共享的特征，暴露出更易分离的路由子空间。在9项zero-shot推理基准上，作者报告Top-1路由提高0.67至1.69分、Top-2提高1.38至1.77分，代价是参数量增加2.9%、每token FLOPs增加2.6%。结果显示专家分工有所改善，但额外计算成本和仅基于基准测试的证据尚不足以证明实际服务效率。

title.en: SinkPruner removes high-norm visual-token sinks without retraining
title.zh: SinkPruner无需再训练即可移除高范数视觉token沉降点

papers.authors: S. Li, Z.-Y. Hu, S. Huang, et al.

summary.en: SinkPruner identifies high-norm visual tokens as redundant attention sinks, removes them with a visual sanitizer, and then retains query-relevant tokens with a text-guided stage. The training-free method is evaluated across 12 image-language and four video-language benchmarks, making it directly relevant to multimodal inference cost. The abstract does not expose the full accuracy-throughput trade-off, so deployment value depends on how aggressively tokens can be pruned without task-specific regressions.
summary.zh: SinkPruner把高范数视觉token识别为冗余的attention sink，先通过视觉清洗器移除，再用文本引导阶段保留与查询相关的token。该方法无需训练，并在12项图文和4项视频语言基准上评估，直接对应多模态推理成本。摘要没有给出完整的准确率—吞吐权衡，因此部署价值取决于在不引发任务特定退化的情况下能剪除多少token。

title.en: Instella-MoE opens a 16-billion-parameter model trained on AMD Instinct
title.zh: Instella-MoE开放一款在AMD Instinct上训练的160亿参数模型

papers.authors: J. Liu, S. Ranjan, P. Mishra, et al.

summary.en: Instella-MoE is a fully open model with 16 billion total parameters and 2.8 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch on AMD MI300X and MI325X GPUs. Its design combines Gated Multi-head Latent Attention with FarSkip-Collective connectivity, and the report claims a 76.7 average across its pre-training benchmark suite. The technical report is useful as a rare open AMD training-system case study, but aggregate benchmark averages do not reveal cluster efficiency or production-serving behavior.
summary.zh: Instella-MoE是一款完全开放的MoE模型，总参数160亿、每token激活28亿参数，并从零开始在AMD MI300X和MI325X GPU上训练。其设计结合Gated Multi-head Latent Attention与FarSkip-Collective连接，报告在预训练基准套件上的平均分为76.7。该技术报告是少见的开放AMD训练系统案例，但综合基准均分无法说明集群效率或生产服务表现。
